import { Component, OnInit, ViewChild, ElementRef, AfterViewInit, Input } from '@angular/core'; import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router'; import { MessagesService } from '@/app/core/services/messages.service'; import { ParticipantService } from '@/app/core/services/participant.service'; import { mockRecipients, Recipient } from '../../../core/data/companies.mock'; import { Message, ConversationItem, ConversationMessage, isSystemMessage } from '@/app/core/models'; export interface ForwardDraft { id: string; originalConversationId: string; recipientIds: string[]; subject: string; body: string; updatedAt: Date; } interface TextFormat { bold: boolean; italic: boolean; underline: boolean; strikethrough: boolean; } @Component({ selector: 'app-forward-conversation', template: `

FORWARD CONVERSATION

Companies {{ getAllCompanies() }}
{{ r.name }} | {{ r.role }}
{{ tempSelectedRecipients.size }} selected
{{ getRecipientName(recipientId) }}
Subject: {{ subject }}
{{ msg.isOwn ? 'You' : msg.sender }}
{{ formatTimestamp(msg.timestamp) }}
{{ msg.replyTo.sender }} {{ msg.replyTo.timestamp }}
{{ att.name }}
{{ att.type }}
{{ att.size }}

You will lose all changes.

Are you sure you want to leave?

`, styles: [` @keyframes fade-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } .animate-fade-in { animation: fade-in 0.3s ease-out; } textarea::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; } textarea::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #f1f1f1; } textarea::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #888; border-radius: 3px; } textarea::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #555; } `] }) export class ForwardConversationComponent implements OnInit, AfterViewInit { @ViewChild('recipientInput') recipientInputRef!: ElementRef; @ViewChild('messageBody') messageBodyRef!: ElementRef; @Input() messageId: string | null = null; recipients = mockRecipients; // Original conversation data conversationId: string = ''; originalMessage: Message | null = null; conversationMessages: ConversationMessage[] = []; // Recipients selection selectedRecipientIds: string[] = []; // Typeahead recipientTypeahead = ''; recipientSuggestions: Recipient[] = []; showRecipientSuggestions = false; // Form fields subject = ''; body = ''; fontSize = '14'; // Rich text formatting textFormat: TextFormat = { bold: false, italic: false, underline: false, strikethrough: false }; // Auto-grow textarea textareaHeight = 100; maxTextareaHeight = 200; lineHeight = 20; // State isDirty = false; showUnsavedModal = false; showToast = false; constructor( private router: Router, private route: ActivatedRoute, private messagesService: MessagesService, private participantService: ParticipantService ) { } ngOnInit() { if (this.messageId) { this.conversationId = this.messageId; this.loadConversation(); } else { this.route.params.subscribe(params => { if (params['id']) { this.conversationId = params['id']; this.loadConversation(); } }); } } ngAfterViewInit() { // Fixed height, no adjustment needed } loadConversation() { // Fetch original message details this.messagesService.getAllMessages().subscribe(messages => { this.originalMessage = messages.find(m => m.id === this.conversationId) || null; if (this.originalMessage) { this.subject = `FW: ${this.originalMessage.subject}`; } }); // Fetch conversation thread this.messagesService.getConversation(this.conversationId).subscribe(data => { if (data && data.messages) { // Filter out system messages and cast to ConversationMessage this.conversationMessages = data.messages .filter(item => !isSystemMessage(item)) as ConversationMessage[]; } }); } getAllCompanies(): string { return this.originalMessage?.companies?.join(', ') || ''; } // Recipients methods focusRecipientInput() { if (this.recipientInputRef) { setTimeout(() => this.recipientInputRef.nativeElement.focus(), 0); } } onRecipientTypeahead() { const query = this.recipientTypeahead.toLowerCase().trim(); if (query.length === 0) { this.recipientSuggestions = []; this.showRecipientSuggestions = false; return; } // Filter recipients // Note: mockRecipients might not be linked to the original message's company in the same way // as NewMessage (where company is selected dynamically). // Here we default to showing all matching recipients or just filtering by company if strict. // Assuming we want to allow forwarding to anyone or just related company people? // Let's filter by the company of the original message if possible to be consistent. const companyName = this.originalMessage?.companies?.[0]; this.recipientSuggestions = this.recipients // .filter(r => ... ) // Optional: valid filtering logic if we have companyId map .filter(r => !this.selectedRecipientIds.includes(r.id)) .filter(r => r.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) || r.role.toLowerCase().includes(query) ) .slice(0, 10); this.showRecipientSuggestions = this.recipientSuggestions.length > 0; } addRecipientFromTypeahead(recipient: Recipient) { if (!this.selectedRecipientIds.includes(recipient.id)) { this.selectedRecipientIds.push(recipient.id); this.markAsDirty(); } this.recipientTypeahead = ''; this.recipientSuggestions = []; this.showRecipientSuggestions = false; this.focusRecipientInput(); } onRecipientBlur() { setTimeout(() => { this.showRecipientSuggestions = false; }, 200); } removeRecipient(recipientId: string) { this.selectedRecipientIds = this.selectedRecipientIds.filter(id => id !== recipientId); this.markAsDirty(); } getRecipientName(recipientId: string): string { return this.recipients.find(r => r.id === recipientId)?.name || ''; } getRecipientIcon(recipient: Recipient): string { const type = this.participantService.getParticipantType(recipient.name); return type === 'banker' ? 'member-banker' : 'member-client'; } getRecipientIconById(recipientId: string): string { const recipient = this.recipients.find(r => r.id === recipientId); if (!recipient) return 'member-client'; return this.getRecipientIcon(recipient); } // Rich text editor methods toggleFormat(format: keyof TextFormat) { this.textFormat[format] = !this.textFormat[format]; this.markAsDirty(); } insertHighlight() { this.markAsDirty(); } insertBulletList() { const textarea = this.messageBodyRef?.nativeElement; if (textarea) { const start = textarea.selectionStart; const end = textarea.selectionEnd; const selectedText = this.body.substring(start, end); const lines = selectedText.split('\n'); const bulletList = lines.map(line => `• ${line}`).join('\n'); this.body = this.body.substring(0, start) + bulletList + this.body.substring(end); this.markAsDirty(); setTimeout(() => { textarea.selectionStart = start; textarea.selectionEnd = start + bulletList.length; textarea.focus(); }, 0); } } insertNumberedList() { const textarea = this.messageBodyRef?.nativeElement; if (textarea) { const start = textarea.selectionStart; const end = textarea.selectionEnd; const selectedText = this.body.substring(start, end); const lines = selectedText.split('\n'); const numberedList = lines.map((line, index) => `${index + 1}. ${line}`).join('\n'); this.body = this.body.substring(0, start) + numberedList + this.body.substring(end); this.markAsDirty(); setTimeout(() => { textarea.selectionStart = start; textarea.selectionEnd = start + numberedList.length; textarea.focus(); }, 0); } } insertLink() { const url = prompt('Enter URL:'); if (url) { const textarea = this.messageBodyRef?.nativeElement; if (textarea) { const start = textarea.selectionStart; const end = textarea.selectionEnd; const selectedText = this.body.substring(start, end) || url; const link = `[${selectedText}](${url})`; this.body = this.body.substring(0, start) + link + this.body.substring(end); this.markAsDirty(); } } } attachFile() { alert('File attachment functionality would be implemented here'); } // Auto-grow textarea onBodyInput() { this.markAsDirty(); } handleKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent) { if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) { switch (event.key.toLowerCase()) { case 'b': event.preventDefault(); this.toggleFormat('bold'); break; case 'i': event.preventDefault(); this.toggleFormat('italic'); break; case 'u': event.preventDefault(); this.toggleFormat('underline'); break; } } } // Utility methods formatTimestamp(timestamp: string): string { // Assume timestamp is ISO string or formatted string // If it's already a formatted string like "10:30 AM", just return it // Check if valid date const date = new Date(timestamp); if (isNaN(date.getTime())) { return timestamp; } const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'); const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0'); const year = date.getFullYear(); const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0'); const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0'); return `${day}.${month}.${year} ${hours}:${minutes}`; } // Form methods markAsDirty() { this.isDirty = true; } validateForm(): boolean { if (this.selectedRecipientIds.length === 0) { return false; } if (!this.subject.trim()) { return false; } return true; } onSend() { if (!this.validateForm()) { return; } console.log('Forwarding conversation:', { originalConversationId: this.conversationId, recipients: this.selectedRecipientIds, subject: this.subject, body: this.body }); this.isDirty = false; this.router.navigate(['/messages']); } onSaveDraft() { if (!this.isDirty) return; const draft: ForwardDraft = { id: 'forward-draft-' + Date.now(), originalConversationId: this.conversationId, recipientIds: [...this.selectedRecipientIds], subject: this.subject, body: this.body, updatedAt: new Date() }; const drafts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('forwardDrafts') || '[]'); drafts.push(draft); localStorage.setItem('forwardDrafts', JSON.stringify(drafts)); this.showToast = true; setTimeout(() => this.showToast = false, 3000); this.isDirty = false; this.router.navigate(['/messages', this.conversationId]); } onBack() { if (this.isDirty) { this.showUnsavedModal = true; } else { this.router.navigate(['/messages', this.conversationId]); } } onDontSave() { this.isDirty = false; this.showUnsavedModal = false; this.router.navigate(['/messages', this.conversationId]); } onSaveDraftAndLeave() { this.showUnsavedModal = false; this.onSaveDraft(); } // Picker Logic showRecipientPicker = false; pickerSearchQuery = ''; tempSelectedRecipients = new Set(); toggleRecipientPicker() { this.showRecipientPicker = !this.showRecipientPicker; if (this.showRecipientPicker) { this.pickerSearchQuery = ''; // Initialize temp set with current selection this.tempSelectedRecipients = new Set(this.selectedRecipientIds); } } isRecipientSelectedInPicker(id: string): boolean { return this.tempSelectedRecipients.has(id); } togglePickerSelection(id: string) { if (this.tempSelectedRecipients.has(id)) { this.tempSelectedRecipients.delete(id); } else { this.tempSelectedRecipients.add(id); } } getFilteredPickerRecipients() { const query = this.pickerSearchQuery.toLowerCase(); return this.recipients.filter(r => !query || r.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) || r.role.toLowerCase().includes(query) ); } applyPickerSelection() { this.selectedRecipientIds = Array.from(this.tempSelectedRecipients); this.markAsDirty(); this.showRecipientPicker = false; } closePicker() { this.showRecipientPicker = false; } }
